label: REAL Kapucu 2022 untreated wells: split-half noise, human iPSC vs rat

wells_needed.note: LOWER BOUND: split-half noise leaves out handling, compound addition and day-to-day variation, which the ToxCast vehicle wells include

implementation_notes: A spike exactly at the cut (half the plate file's last spike time) starts the second half; the plate's last spike ends it.
Wells are the union of the spike file and the expLog, as in the asset; a well with no spikes has 0 active electrodes and is not usable.
Replication noisy electrodes are read from the DIV column of the series' table.
A feature's change is also unscored when a half's value is non-finite; for synchrony_index (STTC), a non-positive second half is floored at 0.05 like any fall.
Usable and per-feature well counts are distinct wells (plate:well); on the replication pool SD pools all of a species' usable well-recordings and the bootstrap draws wells.
P2 is judged on the primary pool, with SD (not the robust SD).
P1 needs the interval's lower end strictly above 1; P3 needs R strictly above 1.
Each R interval uses a fresh generator with seed 20261028, drawing human then rat per resample; resamples with SD_rat = 0 would be dropped and are counted as nonfinite.
The overlap check uses the usable primary wells: each species' 10th and 90th percentile (numpy linear) of the full-recording firing rate; wells inside both ranges, ends included.
Wells needed use the primary pool's firing-rate SD of d for each species.
